newsitem.title: USA: Mass. unemployment rate up to 4.1 pct in December.
newsitem.headline: Mass. unemployment rate up to 4.1 pct in December.

text.p: The Massachusetts unemployment rate for December was 4.1 percent, up from November's revised rate of 4.0 percent, the state's Division of Employment and Training said.
The national unemployment rate for December was 5.3 percent, the same as the revised November rate of 5.3 percent, the state agency said.
"We're still below the national average," said DET spokesman Wallace Graham, adding, "And we're a lot better than we were just a few years ago."
Nils Nordberg, DET deputy director, said, "Although our rate rose slightly in December, we are still 1.1 percentage point below 5.2, where we were a year ago in December 1995."
